Name: Fishking's SVE Seasonal Portraits
Author: IcyShark
Description:
This mod is only meant to be use with Portraiture since I haven't figured out how to make a CP version
Sandy isn't included since she is already in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29703]Fishking's All Seasonal Portraits [/url]
[color=#ff0000]Also, there is a problem with some of the shop vendor (Suki, Bear, Junimos, other Joja employees) not displaying the hd portraits using Portraiture and Portraiture Plus, this has also bothered me too oof. (Martin, Marlon and Claire works fine though!)[/color]
[color=#ff0000]I'm currently working my brain to make a small mod to try and perhaps fix this using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36813]Scale Up Unofficial[/url]. Though I'm afraid the mod won't be out soon though T-T[/color]

[b][i](For any guide regarding Portraiture, please refer to the original mod or you find me on the SDV discord, I'll try my best to help ^-^)[/i][/b]
------------------------
[b]Requirements:[/b]
Portraiture
PortraiturePlus
Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE

------------------------
[b]Instructions for Portraiture:[/b]
1) Download  [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5969]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic for SVE[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24534]PortraiturePlus[/url]. Extract them and put them in your Mod folder
2) Download this mod and move the Fishking's SVE Seasonal folder into Mods/Portraiture/Portraits, it will look like this:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/qR5Z8yC9/Screenshot-2026-09-08-004808.png[/img]
2) Load up the game to generate a config file for Portraiture, at default the file should look like this (either "none" or "Vanilla" will be shown)

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/vm1n4nMj/Screenshot-2026-09-08-003513.png[/img]
3) Open up the config to change the single line: "active": "Vanilla", into  "active": "Fishking's SVE Seasonal", If it is already changed then there's no need!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGcBnBxL/Screenshot-2026-09-08-003522.png[/img]
4) And you're done! Open up the game and press P until the portrait shows up when talking to a villager~

[color=#ff0000][size=5]NOTE:[/size][/color]
If you want your folder in Mods/Portraiture/Portraits to have a different name make sure both the NAME of your folder and the NAME of the "active" line in the config are the SAME when loading up the game!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/wMbyxxZ1/Screenshot-2026-09-08-004722.png[/img]
